description: The pie chart presents the distribution of emotion categories in the context of the paper “Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech,” showing 6 slices in total. The slices are labeled Neutral (dark blue/purple) at approximately 23.1%, Happiness (medium blue) at about 8.1%, Excitement (red) at about 14.1%, Sadness (orange) at about 14.7%, Anger (yellow) at about 14.9%, and Frustration (light blue/cyan) at about 25.1%. Percentage values are printed inside each slice, and the category names are placed around the pie; there is no separate legend visible, no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the slice sizes do not appear to follow a strict ascending or descending order around the circle.
